anyOf.description: distribute only: h = horizontally, v = vertically; null otherwise.
align only: the edge or centre line to align to; null otherwise.

footprintIds.description: The stable footprint ids from selection.inspect or board-inspect (1–16).

gridNm.description: snap-to-grid only: the grid pitch in whole nanometres; null otherwise.

mode.description: align: line the footprints up on one edge or centre line (2 or more); distribute: space them evenly along an axis (3 or more); snap-to-grid: move each onto the grid.

edits.description: 1–16 dimension edits, applied together as one change.

a.description: add only: the first measured point; null for update / remove.

b.description: add only: the second measured point; null for update / remove.

dimensionId.description: update / remove only: the stable id of an existing dimension; null for add.

anyOf.description: add (required) / update: horizontal measures the X distance between a and b, vertical the Y distance, aligned the straight-line distance; null keeps the kind on update.
add / update: a documentation layer; null means silkTop on add, unchanged on update.

offsetNm.description: add (required, non-zero) / update: signed distance of the dimension line from the measured points in whole nanometres — horizontal: + is down (+y); vertical: + is right (+x); aligned: + is the right-hand side walking from a to b on screen; null keeps it on update.

op.description: add a new dimension; update an existing one in place; remove one.

precision.description: add / update: displayed decimal places, 0–4; null means 2 on add, unchanged on update.

strokeWidthNm.description: add / update: line and label stroke in whole nanometres; null means 0.15 mm on add, unchanged on update.

textHeightNm.description: add / update: label height in whole nanometres, at least 100000 (0.1 mm); null means 1 mm on add, unchanged on update.

anyOf.description: add / update: the unit of the displayed value; null means mm on add, unchanged on update.

moves.description: 1–16 footprint moves, each to an absolute position.

x.description: Absolute X of the footprint origin in integer nanometres (+x right).

y.description: Absolute Y of the footprint origin in integer nanometres (+y down, so moving up means a smaller y).

intent.description: One-line engineering intent for the whole bounded proposal (max 240 chars).

targets.description: 1–16 footprints, each with its new absolute rotation, its new side, or both.

footprintId.description: The stable footprint id from selection.inspect or board-inspect (not the reference designator).

rotationDeg.description: The new ABSOLUTE rotation in whole degrees 0–359, counter-clockwise as seen on screen. null with a side change turns the part over the way the editor's Flip does (the rotation becomes 360 minus the current rotation); null without one keeps the current rotation.

anyOf.description: The board side to place the footprint on. null keeps the current side.

edits.description: 1–16 silkscreen TEXT edits, applied together as one change.

atNm.description: add only: where the text is centred; null for update / remove.

x.description: X of the text centre in integer nanometres (+x right).

y.description: Y of the text centre in integer nanometres (+y down).

heightNm.description: add / update: cap height in whole nanometres, at least 100000 (0.1 mm); null means 1 mm on add, unchanged on update.

anyOf.description: add (required) / update: the silkscreen layer; null keeps the layer on update.

op.description: add a new silk text; update an existing silk text; remove one.

silkId.description: update / remove only: the stable id of an existing silk TEXT item (from selection-inspect or an earlier executed result); null for add.

strokeWidthNm.description: add / update: stroke width in whole nanometres; null means 0.15 mm on add, unchanged on update.

text.description: add (required) / update: 1–64 printable ASCII characters; null keeps the text on update.

direction.description: undo your latest change, or redo the change your latest undo reverted.
